title: "Enterprise Guide: Preventing Data Breaches & Handling the Aftermath"
description: The article provides a comprehensive guide on how to prevent data breaches in an enterprise, including implementing strong access control, encrypting sensitive data, regular system updates, conducting security audits, and training employees on security best practices. It also outlines steps to take in case of a data breach, such as identifying and containing the breach, assessing its impact, notifying affected parties, investigating the breach, and monitoring systems post-recovery.

title: Transparent Risk Management for AI Projects in Banks
description: Navigating AI project decisions in large enterprises like banks requires a transparent and structured approach to risk management. By defining risks clearly—covering technical, operational, regulatory, ethical, and financial aspects—stakeholders can align on potential challenges. Engaging cross-departmental teams early, using robust risk mitigation strategies like data governance and model validation, and communicating risks in business terms ensure better decision-making. Leveraging tools like dashboards, ethical AI frameworks, and regulatory sandboxes fosters trust and transparency. A culture of open dialogue and continuous learning further strengthens AI project outcomes while addressing risks proactively.
